title: sleepwell state
description: Persistent state of the sleepwell loop. Lives at .sleepwell/state.json inside the repo where the loop runs. Schema v3.1: adds optional CI circuit-breaker fields (ci_attempts, max_ci_attempts_per_branch, max_actions_minutes_per_run, max_actions_cost_usd) on top of v3 (context_threshold_pct, phases). Migration: v1/v2/v3 states load normally; new fields fall back to defaults. See lib/ritual.md §8 for details.

version.description: Schema version. v1/v2 = legacy, v3 = current (default for new runs). v1 and v2 are still accepted for resumes.

intent_file.description: Path to long-form intent file (alternative to inline string). v2.

slug.description: Kebab-case slug derived from the intent.

mode.description: Operation mode. wave is experimental (3 sub-agents per iter).

branch.description: Loop-isolated branch. v3+: always `sleepwell/auto/<run-id>` for new runs; legacy runs may keep `sleepwell/<slug>`.

run_id.description: Unique run identifier (`<unix-epoch>-<rand4hex>`). Used to name the branch and avoid collisions. v3, optional (older runs lack it).

pr_url.description: URL of the PR created via /sleepwell:sleepwell-pr at the end of the run. v3, optional.

pr_mode.description: PR creation mode on finalize. `auto` = create PR at end (default); `none` = never create (--no-pr); `draft` = create as draft (--draft-pr). v3.

worktree_path.description: Absolute worktree path, or null when running without a worktree.

stop_when.description: Natural-language condition evaluated at the end of each iter.

no_voice.description: Persisted CLI flag (--no-voice). Skips voice profile extraction. v2.

no_meta.description: Persisted CLI flag (--no-meta). Skips meta-calibration. v2.

consecutive_failures.description: Reset to 0 on each PASS. ≥3 → abort.

verify_cmds.description: Verification commands. Each field accepts a shell command or the literal sentinel "auto" (loop detects at boot).

lint.description: Lint command, or "auto" for automatic detection.

tokens_used.description: Accumulated token usage of the loop. v2.

cost_so_far_usd.description: Accumulated cost in USD (derived from tokens_used). v2.

cost_budget_usd.description: Budget configured via --max-cost <USD>. When cost_so_far_usd >= cost_budget_usd → abort. v2.

max_cost_per_iter_usd.description: Per-iter cost guardrail (--max-cost-per-iter <USD>). An iter that exceeds this cost aborts as FAIL and enters exponential backoff; does not count as a total abort. See lib/ritual.md §8.1. v2.

voice_profile_at.description: When the cached voice profile was generated.

context_threshold_pct.description: Context pressure (% of model_context_window) above which automatic pruning fires: truncates notes.md to the last 20 entries and removes last_diff cache > 5MB. See skills/sleepwell-loop/SKILL.md §6.5. v3, optional.

phases.description: Internal sub-phases of the run (see lib/ritual.md §9). v3, optional.

last_eval.description: Heuristic evaluation of the last iter, produced by the sleepwell-evaluator skill. v3, optional.

observation.description: Short observation (≤200 chars) about the iter.

course_correct.description: When true, the next iter must course-correct. 2× in a row → escalation.

ci_green.description: Last sleepwell-ci-monitor check returned conclusion=success. Updated on each wake. v3.1.

ci_waiting_iters.description: Consecutive iterations where ci-monitor returned pending. If >5 → loop enters wait_long (longer ScheduleWakeup sleep). Reset to 0 on green/fix. v3.1.

last_push_sha.description: SHA of the last commit pushed by the sleepwell-loop skill. Used by ci-monitor to validate that the CI run matches the right commit (headSha == last_push_sha). v3.1.

ci_attempts.description: CI circuit breaker: fix attempts per branch. Key = branch name; value = counter and metrics. v3.1.

max_ci_attempts_per_branch.description: Maximum CI-fix attempts per branch before aborting with reason ci_attempts_exceeded. v3.1.

max_actions_minutes_per_run.description: Cap on GitHub Actions minutes consumed per run. v3.1.

max_actions_cost_usd.description: Cap on GitHub Actions USD cost consumed per run. v3.1.

prediction_profile.description: Prediction profile produced by sleepwell-helper calibrate. v3, optional. See sleepwell-meta skill.

overall.description: Overall accuracy (0..1) of loop predictions in past runs.

by_category.description: Accuracy by category (e.g.: feat, fix, refactor, or by mode).

ci_lock.description: Lock file metadata when a sleepwell loop is active. Removed on finalize.
